text:
soph: quick UX review for the routing rules editor. pushed a compact variant where rules are tighter, priority reorder is drag/keyboard, and the preview sandbox is gated when validations fail. looking for a11y + copy + focus behavior checks. figma: https://figma.mock/rules-compact ivan: :eyes: nice. main issues: 1) when tabbing the sticky mini-help overlaps the top rule; 2) chips at 14px might fail contrast; 3) keyboard reorder needs clear affordances and announcements. meera: contrast quick check: chip bg #F6F8FB + text #0F1724 = 3.9:1 at 14px. fails. option: darken text to #071018 (4.7:1) or slightly darken bg. prefer darkening text to keep token harmony. diego: copy for gated preview: current "Preview disabled" is terse. suggestion: "Preview sandbox is disabled until validation issues are resolved." slightly longer but clearer for screen readers. also avoid using "fix" as a verb. soph: agree on both. decision lean: darken chip text to #071018 at 14px; change banner copy to diego's suggestion; keep density. ivan: keyboard reorder notes: use Enter/Space to pick up, Arrow keys to move, Enter to drop. announce moves via role=status aria-live polite: e.g.,
Rule moved to position 2
Also ensure the drag handle has a 32px hit target and a visible focus outline. meera: focus clipping: prefer auto-scroll on :focus-visible with scroll-margin-top equal to header height, but only for keyboard modality. avoids layout jumps for pointer users. snippet: .rule-item:focus-visible { scroll-margin-top: var(--header-height); outline: 2px solid #2563EB; } also add aria-hidden on preview when gated and role=status on the banner. ux-bot: accessibility checklist: contrast >=4.5:1 for 14px, aria-live polite on validation and move announcements, aria-hidden on preview when disabled, focus-visible management, and i18n key for new copy. soph: can someone open a small PR with CSS token change, aria updates, and a couple visual-regression screenshots (normal + gated preview)? include i18n key: preview.sandbox.disabled_unresolved = "Preview sandbox is disabled until validation issues are resolved." and a short e2e for keyboard reorder announcements. diego: i'll open branch diego/compact-rules-a11y with tests and screenshots. i'll ping ux-bot for the checks. ivan: one more tiny UX ask: when preview is gated, keep the toggle visible but disabled with aria-describedby linking to the banner so screen readers get context when they tab to the control. soph: perfect. thanks team :thumbsup:
